answer: Each identity locks 80 credits in a reef fund and must forge one work record each epoch, bound to its reef anchor on a mesa board. A lottery draws 5 percent each epoch; auditors recompute the drawn record from its anchor, and a missing or mismatched record burns the bond. Forge fees rise per batch: the kth record by one operator costs 20+5k credits, so the 1,000th costs 5,020 and 1,000 fakes pay 2,522,500 plus 80,000 in bonds. A forge-rental ring fails because a rented record carries the wrong anchor and the mesa comparison burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 25 once and keeps its bond.
